turn: The consent scopes step is finished and committed as "feat(scopes): load study list from registry config". `load_studies` in src/scopes/studies.py now reads config/studies.yaml and returns a dict keyed by study ID. The config currently lists two studies, CARDIO-07 (Heart failure cohort) and ONCO-12 (Breast cancer biobank). I haven't run the code or any tests. I only wrote the loader and the config, so the loader is unverified. In the same commit I also made a small unplanned fix. The loader had no explicit file encoding, so I set it to UTF-8, which stops study titles with accented characters from failing to load on systems with a different default locale. Next I will start "Validation of consent form versions".

sidefix.title: Open study config as UTF-8
sidefix.what: Set the config file encoding to UTF-8 so non-ASCII study titles load the same way on every system.
